summary: Verified the Role Briefing fix for crew invites (WhatsApp preview/copy + invite email). Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (new file test_invite_role_briefings.py), including a direct call to crew.invite_crew with send_email mocked: a briefing sent only in payload.briefings for a selected role (Port Trim) is used, the server-side Starboard Trim briefing is still included, a payload briefing for an unselected role (Mainsheet) is ignored, and the order follows the roles. Real POST /api/boats/main/invites with roles ['Starboard Trim'] + briefings + send_email true returned 200 (email provider gave 202). Invites with no roles/briefings, send_email false (the invite is saved and shows in GET /crew), >20 briefing keys -> 422, POST /briefings resend (404 for a non-crew member, 200 {sent, skipped}) and GET /crew/agreement role briefing all still work. UI (390px, Pro): edited Starboard Trim via checklist-item-edit-10 -> edit-item-briefing-input -> edit-item-confirm-btn, then Crew -> Invite. Starboard Trim was not ticked so it was typed into the RolePicker, plus the Helm chip. crew-message-preview showed '*Role briefing - Starboard Trim*' followed by the 2-line briefing, and nothing for Helm (no briefing). crew-invite-message-btn copied text identical to the preview, and the POST payload had briefings {'Starboard Trim': ...} with send_email false. Typing the role in lower case ('starboard trim') still matched, and the email mode POST returned 200 with the briefing in the payload. No bugs found.

minor.issue: InviteIn.briefings values have no per-value max_length (they are only cut to 2000 chars server-side after parsing), so very large strings are accepted. Consider Dict[str, constr(max_length=2000)].

critical_code_review_comments: crew.py create invite merge is correct: it only takes payload keys whose role_label(k).lower() is in the selected roles, and phone values override server values (intended, since the phone copy is newer).
Optional: add a per-value length limit to the InviteIn.briefings values in the Pydantic model.
Existing tests/test_crew_invites_v2.py fails at collection when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL isn't exported (no load_dotenv). This is a test-harness issue only.
